title: Window Functions — Ranking & Aggregation
description:
## Window Functions
Window functions calculate values across a set of rows related to the current row - without collapsing them like GROUP BY does.

- `RANK() OVER (ORDER BY col)` - assigns a rank
- `ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY col)` - assigns a row number
- `SUM(col) OVER (ORDER BY col)` - running total
Every row stays - but each gets a rank based on the window.


---
## Assignment:
BWS needs to prioritize tickets. Select each ticket's id, title, escalation_level, and its rank ordered by escalation_level descending. Name the rank column `priority_rank`.
setupCode: CREATE TABLE tickets (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, assigned_to TEXT, escalation_level INTEGER); INSERT INTO tickets (title, assigned_to, escalation_level) VALUES ('Server outage', 'Alice', 5), ('Bucket misconfigured', 'Bob', 3), ('Deploy failed', 'Steve', 4);
expectedOutput:
id | title | escalation_level | priority_rank
1 | Server outage | 5 | 1
3 | Deploy failed | 4 | 2
2 | Bucket misconfigured | 3 | 3
